$schema-note: Known queue-RPC contract violations, one entry per violation key. Each value must say WHY the violation is tolerated -- normally the WHERE guard that makes the omission safe, which scripts/check-queue-rpc-contract.mjs cannot see statically. A NEW violation fails the build; an entry here that no longer reproduces also fails, so this list can only shrink. Regenerate keys with `npm run tools:queue-rpc:baseline`, then rewrite the generated messages by hand -- an unreasoned entry is how a real defect hides.
auto_dial_queue:missing-column:assigned:: GUARDED, but unaligned. The row is selected with `cq.queue_state IS NULL OR cq.queue_state = 'queued'` and updated by that id, and every writer that leaves a row queued (reset_campaign, cancel_messages, cancel_outreach_attempts, reset_stale_campaign_queue_claims, handle_campaign_queue_entry) nulls provider_status, so it is already NULL. Its three sibling claim paths -- claim_next_queue_contact, claim_campaign_queue_contacts, select_and_update_campaign_contacts -- still null it explicitly rather than lean on that invariant. Aligning auto_dial_queue with them would let this entry go; it is the weakest of the five.
cancel_messages:missing-column:queued:de: GUARDED and deliberate. `WHERE dequeued_at IS NULL` excludes terminal rows entirely, so the dequeued_* trio is already NULL on every row this touches. 20260722120000's header states the intent outright: terminal rows (opt-out and friends) must stay terminal, because a cancel must not resurrect them. Writing the trio here would be the bug.
cancel_outreach_attempts:missing-column:: GUARDED and deliberate. Identical shape to cancel_messages, keyed by call sid instead of message sid, with the same `WHERE dequeued_at IS NULL` guard and the same reason.
requeue_campaign_queue_contact:missing-c: GUARDED. The function returns 'not_found' unless its opening SELECT matches `cq.id = queue_id_pro AND cq.dequeued_at IS NULL`, so the UPDATE is unreachable for a terminal row and the trio is already NULL. Note this RPC has no application caller at all -- scripts/db/check-db-orphans.mjs KEEPs it as a test-exercised queue helper -- so nothing user-facing depends on the omission either way.
reset_stale_campaign_queue_claims:missin: GUARDED. `WHERE cq.dequeued_at IS NULL AND cq.queue_state = 'assigned' AND cq.claimed_at IS NOT NULL AND ...` -- it reclaims stale live claims only, so the dequeued_* trio is NULL by construction on every row it touches.
